name: mx-fibra-prospectus
display_name: Mexico FIBRA — Prospecto de Colocación (Offering Prospectus)
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint) Mexican FIBRA offering prospectus (Prospecto de Colocación de CBFIs) template — Spanish, LISR arts. 187-188 / LMV / CNBV-RNV / Indeval, a CBFI/trust-securitization register distinct from a Canadian share/unit prospectus. Closest existing relative is legal-prospectus (Canada NI 41-101), but architecturally different: Spanish taxonomy (Portada/Índice/Glosario/Personas Responsables) with no Canadian analogue; a FIBRA/CBFI trust-securitization Portada two-column term-block; a bordered AVISO IMPORTANTE legend distinct from a lighter interior .aviso notice box; a Personas Responsables signature register with one-responsible-party-per-page pagination; no running header on any page (matched to the companion Trust).

variants.name: portada
variants.description: Cover with RNV/CNBV registration legends, logo, headline + Monto, and a two-column term-block (bold label left / justified value right, dl.portada-terms).

variants.name: aviso-importante
variants.description: Mandatory cover legend box: bordered, bold, uppercase, centered head.

variants.name: indice
variants.description: Table of contents, bold-caps top-level rows, dot-leader convention.

variants.name: glosario
variants.description: Two-column borderless table (26%/74% term/definition split), hairline header rule only (body rows borderless).

variants.name: body-section
variants.description: Numbered section heads bold/left/uppercase (SOMA prospectus register — deliberately NOT centered like the Trust's clause heads); the lighter .aviso interior notice box (Section 5's "base de las cifras" disclosure) is a visually distinct sibling of the cover's .aviso-importante, not a duplicate.

variants.name: financial-data-table
variants.description: Economía de la colocación / Parámetros y objetivos clave tables: right-aligned tabular figures, bold subtotal/total rows, 2pt double closing rule (accounting convention), footnote register at 9.5pt.

variants.name: org-chart-exhibit
variants.description: Section 4.4's "Relaciones intercorporativas" figure. Styled and maintained as its own separate reusable component (org-chart-print) — not part of this recipe's own token set; this recipe only fixes its page-margin coupling and splices the figure into the section flow.

variants.name: personas-responsables
variants.description: Eight responsible-party signature blocks (table.signature-block, never a bordered div), one party per page: Fideicomitente, Administrador, Fiduciario, Representante Común, Intermediario Colocador, Agente Estructurador, Auditor Externo, Asesor Legal Independiente.

aria: Índice entries, financial tables (<table><caption> + <th scope>), and the Glosario are real structural markup, not images. Both notice boxes (.aviso-importante/.aviso) are required statutory/informational disclosures, not decorative — must remain in the accessibility tree. The org-chart exhibit's own aria requirements are owned by org-chart-print.

wcag.note: Pure black-on-white register; role/notice distinctions are conveyed by border weight + text register (bold/uppercase vs. sentence case), never by color alone.

motion: Print-first static document — no interaction states; renders to PDF via WeasyPrint via project-documents/bin/build-pdf.py "shape 1" (single render — this family, unlike the Trust, does not need the split-and-merge workaround since it has no per-schedule page counters).
open_questions: oq-1: should the figure-wrapper conventions (figure { break-inside: avoid; text-align: center }, figcaption styling) be claimed by this recipe, by org-chart-print, or by a shared Paper figure primitive? Currently unclaimed by either — a real seam to close.

oq-2: should the Portada/AVISO/Glosario conventions established here become the shared house default for all future Mexican FIBRA/CBFI-style prospectuses, or are they specific to this offering? Mirrors the companion Trust recipe's oq-1.

oq-3 (cross-reference, not this recipe's own decision): page-margin-inline (0.625in) is pinned by org-chart-print's fixed-pixel-width canvas (680px, needs >=7.08in of column width) -- do not widen this family's margins toward the Trust's ~1in without first revisiting org-chart-print's canvas width.
